levels.surface: محمد بن عبد، الله بن نمير الهمداني

notes: two «ح» branches: they meet at «قالوا حدثنا الأعمش» and the tail after it is shared (rule 3)
«- واللفظ له -» is an editor gloss, left out
«أبي» in «حدثنا أبي» is the father of Muhammad b. Abdullah b. Numayr, relation (the second occurrence of the word in the text, the first is inside «أبي شيبة»)
«عبد الله» is the Companion Ibn Mas'ud, named by the text as «عن عبد الله»
